source: Synchronous rotation is ASSUMED as a display convention: no rotation period of K2-18 b is measured, and Sarkis et al. (2018) report none. Pole, prime meridian and rate are computed from the hosted orbit in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/k2-18b.json.
coordinateSystem: ICRF/J2000. +Z is the orbit normal (prograde spin); +X points at the host star at each instant, so longitude 0 is the substellar point; east longitude, the direction of rotation.
qualification: Tidal locking and a spin axis on the orbit normal are assumptions, not measurements: neither the rotation period nor the obliquity of K2-18 b is measured.
